entities.name: Kurt-Caesar Hoffmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kurt-Caesar Hoffmann was a senior naval commander in the German Navy (Kriegsmarine) during World War II, who commanded the battleship Scharnhorst. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross.
